versions.changelog:
Initial release of loop-skill.

- Enables plan-driven, unattended multi-agent loop orchestration for any coding-agent CLI.
- Main agent reads repositories, generates/updates advancement plans, then dispatches tasks to CLIs automatically.
- Supports persistent loops, recoverable sessions, and dashboard monitoring.
- Zero manual configuration required; automatically scans, plans, ingests, and starts loops on multiple repositories.
- Provides safe, confirmable workflow for removing advancement plans from workspace without deleting source code.
